scope: Controller read every word in two complete chunks before rejection.
findings: Many descriptions append a fragment: within the assessed exchange. This is padding and not an argument.

Most Locked score sentences splice lowercased truncated portions of earlier clauses and end mid-thought; several contain duplicated fragments. A zero repeated-six-word result does not establish coherent or nonformulaic prose.

Pro biblical-source description substitutes canonization for the actually offered comparison with historical use of Quran/Hadith and distinct Gospel streams. Pro Paul critique introduces grief where the limited locked inference concerns his reported experience.

Negative burden repeatedly shifts to proving a full alternative history, even where the move only blocks an evidential inference; a causal-development burden applies to an affirmatively proposed mechanism or sufficiency assertion only.
Con empty-tomb description must explicitly attribute the conference report and acknowledge Winger distinguished majority from consensus; the wider report cannot be described as verified.

AI Posterior Ceiling claims an absolute bound and that only new independent evidence can raise it; dependent evidence may add conditional information and support for source reliability can change confidence.
AI pro conclusion should state a conditional affirmative inference, with specified premises, rather than abandon the motion for merely serious probability.
Current editorialReview flags are not reliable evidence of completed prose inspection.
